source.description: SGP4 propagation of supplied catalog mean elements; not measured positions.

status_meaning.1: mean eccentricity is outside the range 0.0 to 1.0
status_meaning.3: perturbed eccentricity is outside the range 0.0 to 1.0
status_meaning.4: semilatus rectum is less than zero
status_meaning.5: (error 5 no longer in use; it meant the satellite was underground)
status_meaning.6: mrt is less than 1.0 which indicates the satellite has decayed

source.velocity_derivation: Centered derivative of SGP4 position curve, +/- 0.25 seconds; transformed with the position to the scene frame. Not the independent SGP4 state-velocity output.
source.interpolation: Cubic Hermite with position and velocity in the declared frame

environment_sources.name: NOAA GloTEC assimilative ionosphere
environment_sources.temporal_policy: Explicit sample hold of 600 seconds; no temporal interpolation
environment_sources.limits: Assimilative model estimates, not direct point observations. TEC is a column plotted at ground coordinates; NmF2 is located at the modeled hmF2 altitude. Quality flag 0 can be background-dominated.

environment_sources.name: IGRF-14 internal main magnetic field
environment_sources.coordinate_system: WGS84 geodetic input; local east/north/up components in nT
environment_sources.limits: Internal main field only; excludes external storm fields, small-scale crustal anomalies and ionospheric currents. Restricted to 0–2,000 km in this adapter.

environment_sources.name: Open-Meteo current weather model output
environment_sources.temporal_policy: Explicit zero-order hold of instantaneous model sample for 900 seconds; not independently established validity
environment_sources.limits: Grid-cell model values; no station observations. Total cloud fraction is a column quantity located at the surface, not a cloud height.
